name: Charterquill
title: Contemporary ceremonial blackletter
description: A contemporary blackletter display face with angular bowls, forked pen strokes, diamond terminals and individual capital flourishes. Intended for cultural identities, editorial titles and distinctive short headings.
story: Old English Text MT is the historical inspiration for independent new artwork. The user selected the fresh OpenAI replacement A in the current ABCv2 review. Protected tracing at a shared scale preserves the 52 source SVGs, and optical spacing moves them horizontally. Authored figures, symbols, composites and Latin forms follow the pen-cut source. Version 0.216 refines companion figures, sharp-s forms and symbols while retaining selected letters. Current-version local verification supplements the earlier remote review.
independent_review: Current 0.216 receives local verification; earlier build reviewed remotely
distribution_terms: Pending owner review. No redistribution license is assigned to these sample font assets. The repository compiler license is unchanged.
build_boundary: Documented project-local compatibility adapter runs the pinned Fontify compiler and gated review; plain JSON CLI cannot directly admit blank NBSP/zero-advance marks. Producer source-stage, compiled and release records are distinct from the integration binary checks.
limitations: Display use from 48px; body text and smaller sizes are not certified.
Exact listed coverage and documented language/one- or two-mark samples only. Arbitrary accent stacks, every Latin orthography and every rendering engine are not certified.
Static Regular TTF/WOFF2 only; no CFF OTF, variable axes or additional styles.

Chrome may change kerning across a discretionary-hyphen boundary. At 48px the documented example measures 234.9125px versus 231.4565px with the control removed; forced-reference pixel identity is not claimed.
